'''Classic (no v-cards) (Modified)''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>classic_no_virtual_m</code>). It has the same pool as [[Classic (no v-cards)]] but allows 14 Defensive Shields: ''A Close Race'', ''A Tragedy Has Occurred'', ''An Unusual Amount Of Fear'', ''Another Pathetic Lifeform'', ''Don't Do That Again'', ''Only Jedi Carry That Weapon'', ''Planetary Defenses'', ''Allegations Of Corruption'', ''Fanfare'', ''Fear Is My Ally'', ''Weapon Of A Sith'', ''[[We'll Let Fate-a Decide, Huh?]]'', ''Wipe Them Out, All Of Them'' and ''You've Never Won A Race?''.<ref name="gemp" /> Cards with the Episode I or Maintenance icon are banned.<ref name="gemp" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" />
